title: 11 U.K. Black Friday Apple deals you don’t want to miss
content:
Macworld

Black Friday started in the U.S. as a day of sales after Thanksgiving and has become a fixture of the U.K. Christmas shopping calendar. With discounts running through the weekend to Cyber Monday, it’s a good time to tick off a few gifts, especially if there’s an iPad, Apple Watch, or pair of AirPods on someone’s wish list.

Amazon has knocked £300 off the iPhone Air and cut the AirPods Pro 3 to £155.98, while Argos has the Apple Watch Ultra 3 for £495. We’ve picked 11 of the best U.K. Black Friday Apple deals, from a £74 AirTag four-pack to a MacBook Pro with £400 off, and explained who each one is best for so you can decide where to spend and where to save.

For more offers, visit our Black Friday coverage and our roundups of the best Apple deals, Mac deals, iPad deals, Apple Watch deals and AirPods deals.

  1. AirPods Pro 3: £155.98 (£63 off at Amazon, RRP £219).
    These are our top AirPods for commuting, flights, and workouts. The foam-infused tips help keep the earbuds in place and improve noise isolation. You also get up to eight hours with noise cancellation on, plus heart-rate sensing and hearing features. Read our AirPods buying guide
  2. iPhone Air (256GB): £799 (£300 off at Amazon, RRP £1,099).
    Buy the iPhone Air if you want a large, smooth display in a phone that feels light in your hand. The slim titanium body and A19 Pro chip are the draw, especially if you mostly use the main rear camera. Read our iPhone buying guide
  3. Apple Watch Ultra 3 (49mm, GPS + Cellular, Bright Blue Trail Loop M/L): £495 (£254 off at Argos, former RRP £749). (If that link doesn’t work, try this.)
    Pick the Ultra 3 for hiking, diving, or long days outdoors. Its bright display is easy to read in sunlight, and you get dual-frequency GPS, satellite connectivity, and up to 42 hours of battery life in a rugged titanium case. Read our Apple Watch buying guide
  4. Mac mini (M6, 256GB SSD, 16GB RAM): £692.70 (£207 off at Amazon, RRP £899).
    If you own a monitor, keyboard, and mouse, the M6 Mac mini is a compact, affordable way to get a desktop Mac. It handles everyday work and photo editing, and can drive up to three displays if you need them. Read our Mac buying guide
  5. MacBook Neo (512GB SSD): £697 (£102 off at Amazon, RRP £799).
    The MacBook Neo is an affordable first Mac for schoolwork, browsing, and writing. The 512GB version doubles the base model’s storage and adds Touch ID for quick sign-ins. Its 8GB of memory is enough if you mostly use lightweight apps. Read our Mac buying guide
  6. 15-inch MacBook Air (M5, 512GB SSD, 16GB RAM): £1,299 (£200 off at Amazon, RRP £1,499).
    Choose this MacBook Air if you want a bigger screen in a laptop that’s still easy to carry. The 15-inch display gives spreadsheets and side-by-side apps more working space, while the M5 chip and 16GB of memory handle everyday multitasking. Read our Mac buying guide
  7. 16-inch MacBook Pro (M5 Pro, 1TB SSD, 24GB RAM): £2,599 (£400 off at Amazon, RRP £2,999).
    The 16-inch MacBook Pro makes sense if you edit video, develop software, or run demanding creative apps on the move. The M5 Pro chip and 24GB of memory handle heavier workloads, and the larger screen gives timelines and toolbars space. Read our Mac buying guide
  8. 11-inch iPad Air (M4, 256GB, Wi-Fi): £740 (£109 off at Amazon, RRP £849).
    The 11-inch iPad Air is our pick for most people who want a tablet for work, study, or creative projects. It’s easy to carry, supports Apple Pencil Pro, and offers 256GB of storage for apps, downloaded video, and larger projects. Read our iPad buying guide
  9. 13-inch iPad Air (M4, 128GB, Wi-Fi): £819.99 (£129 off at Amazon, RRP £949).
    Choose the 13-inch iPad Air if you want space to sketch, annotate full-page PDFs, or keep class notes beside a textbook. It’s our best-value big-screen iPad, and adding a Magic Keyboard makes typing at a desk a more comfortable experience. Read our iPad buying guide
  10. Apple Watch Series 12 (46mm, GPS): £359 (£60 off at Amazon, RRP £419).
    The Series 12 is our everyday Apple Watch pick, especially if you’re upgrading from a Series 9 or earlier. The 46mm display gives workout stats more room, while improved heart-rate sensing and the Readiness score are key reasons to upgrade. Read our Apple Watch buying guide
  11. AirTag (2nd generation, four-pack): £74 (£25 off at Amazon, RRP £99).
    A four-pack makes sense if you want to track several things, such as keys, luggage, and school bags. Apple’s Find My app helps locate them, while a louder alert and longer-range Precision Finding make a misplaced item easier to pinpoint. Read our second-generation AirTag review

Apple is offering gift cards worth up to £240 with eligible purchases from 27 to 30 November, so it’s worth comparing Apple’s Black Friday offer with the upfront discounts above if you already have another Apple purchase in mind.
